timeline.text: Our kids' quiz deck treated every day the same — even weekends, with no homework due.
Homework also showed up as its own card, cutting into whatever subject a kid was actually studying.
Now a Cloudflare Workers routine checks the weekday, picks today's real subjects, and tags the match 'I dag.'
Homework rides along on that same subject's card instead of butting in as its own.
Weekends now show zero homework — the deck finally rests the way school already does.
